resolved.title: For 循环
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]For Loop[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

[b]Loops[/b] are used to repeat code until a certain condition holds.
The only loop construct in Go is [b]for[/b], which has three components: [b]init[/b], [b]condition[/b], [b]post statement[/b].

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="go" codeId="3318"]for i:=0; i<5; i++ {
   fmt.Println(i)
}[/code]
The code above will output the numbers 0 to 4, as we initialize the value of[b] i[/b] to 0 and increment it while the condition [b]i<5[/b] holds.
[note][b]i++[/b] is a shorter version of [b]i = i+1[/b] and is called the [b]increment[/b] [b]operator[/b].[/note]

resolved.title: For 循环
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]For Loop[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The [b]init[/b] and [b]post[/b] statements can be omitted.

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="go" codeId="3319"]sum := 1
res := 0
for sum <= 1000 {
  res += sum
  sum++
}
fmt.Println(res) [/code]
The code above will calculate the sum of numbers from 1 to 1000.
[note]Note that with just the condition, [b]for[/b] becomes similar to [b]while[/b] loops available in other programming languages.[/note]

content.title: 指数增长

resolved.title: 指数增长
resolved.problem_statement_md:
某实验室的兔子数量每年**2倍增长**。

该实验室最初有7只兔子。
你的程序需要计算出提供的输入年限后将有多少只兔子。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Exponential Growth[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The population of rabbits at a lab [b]doubles[/b] every year.

The lab was started initially with 7 rabbits. Your program needs to calculate the number of rabbits you will have after the number of years provided as input.

[b]Sample Input:[/b]
4

[b]Sample Output:[/b]
112

Use a loop to calculate the number of rabbits after each year. 
[note][b]Explanation[/b]: Let's break down the population growth by year:
Year 0: 7
Year 1: 14
Year 2: 28
Year 3: 56
Year 4: [b]112[/b][/note]
resolved.hint_md: 使用一个循环来计算每一年后的兔子数量。
